workflow.reproducibility_note: Reference acquisition and guide-generation commands and full index/alignment trials are in the linked release-116 repeated-panel record. Workflow outputs and indices were temporary and removed after summary.

interpretation: The real workflow routed both aligners through downstream parsing, evidence reconciliation, and gate evaluation with identical outputs.

All candidates correctly remained provisional and gate verdicts unknown because the human query-species transcriptome was not screened. This run does not establish human biological eligibility or qualified-output equivalence.
Rat and macaque gate values do not substitute for the missing human query-species evidence.
The synthetic miRNA fixture is software-only and supports no biological inference.
